name: BUAN Bundle Profiles
summary: Computes BUAN bundle profiles for one subject with DIPY: assigns points of a recognised bundle to segments along a model bundle and samples an anatomical measure such as FA along them, saving CSV files.
description: Implements the bundle-profile step of Bundle Analytics (BUAN): the model bundle (standard space) and the subject's recognised bundle (common space) define an assignment of points to no_disks segments, and the measure map is sampled on the subject's bundle in native space. Use it after bundle recognition to obtain along-tract profiles for group statistics. As committed, profiles.py on this branch has a syntax error and does not import json, and the registry parameter key is malformed, so the App is unlikely to run.

parameters.description: The number of segments along the length of the tract.
